title: [GMCP 203.025.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: OAuth-protected MCP resource server
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-025-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Remote GMCP endpoints implement current MCP authorization and OAuth resource-server requirements: protected-resource metadata, authorization-server discovery, issuer and audience validation, scopes, challenges, PKCE-facing metadata, token expiry/revocation and TLS. Token passthrough is impossible, resource and authorization roles remain separated, and confused-deputy, mix-up, replay and malformed-token suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
